name: Otoko no Ko Paradise
source:
Adventure game omnibus of 10 titles about crossdressing girl-boys.

"Otoko no Ko Assault Sorority" 
A concert of crossdressers being violated by vulgar male assailants. 

"Abandoned Church Angel" 
A young man who committed a crime visits a disused church. There he meets... 

"Dragonfly Diary" 
Two gorgeous brothers in a taboo relationship... 

"In the Classroom" 
Young boys play in their trunks before the start of swim class. 

"Russian Doll" 
The imagined love and indulgence of a beautiful blind boy. 

"Crossdressing Maid Cafe [Banana Inn]" 
He's a handsome innocent working at a maid cafe who needs guidance. 

"Ten Nights" 
A twin ponytail crossdresser sneaks into an elementary school and engages in abnormality... 

"Backstage of the Idol Dream Singer"
A national idol secretly appears on a members-only night club stage. 

"Little Mr. Precious" 
He's a crossdresser working in a department store, violated in the anus by a female customer... 

"Forbidden Bride" 
The boy with the gentle heart is abducted and cruelly ravished. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE062255.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
冒险游戏综合体，包含10款关于男扮女装的游戏。

《男之子突击联谊会》一场变装者遭到粗俗男性袭击者侵犯的音乐会。

《被遗弃的教堂天使》一名犯罪的年轻人参观了一座废弃的教堂。在那里他遇见了… 

《蜻蜓日记》两个有着禁忌关系的帅气兄弟…… 

《在课堂上》游泳课开始前，小男孩们穿着泳裤玩耍。

《俄罗斯娃娃》一个美丽的盲童想象中的爱和放纵。

《变装女仆咖啡厅【香蕉旅馆】》他是一位在女仆咖啡厅工作、需要指导的英俊无辜者。

《十夜》一个双马尾变装者潜入小学并进行变态…… 

《偶像梦歌手后台》国民偶像秘密出现在会员制夜店舞台上。

《小宝贝先生》他是一名在百货公司工作的变装者，被一名女顾客侵犯肛门…… 

《禁忌新娘》内心温柔的男孩被绑架并被残酷蹂躏。
